window_convention: window_mV is nominal half-width class; actual_T_mV is resistor-ratio half-width
held_cap_definition: per input; plus 1 fF detector shunt per input
decision_time_definition: conservative service time; not a direct 760 ps sampling strobe
energy_definition: maximum tested complete-event positive-delivered subtotal; excludes input sources and external timing-generator internal energy
disturbance_definition: maximum absolute signed detector-minus-removed shift across 25 matched held events at fixed time; not temporal peak
